title: Builder for a Messaging Service
instructions: Implement `Message.builder()` and the nested `MessageBuilder` in `config/message_data.py`. The chained setters (`message_type`, `content`, `sender`, `recipient`, `is_delivered`, `timestamp`) each store a value and return the builder; `build()` returns a `Message` that later setter calls must not change. The `Builder` interface in `config/builder.py` is provided.

evidence.label: builder() returns a fresh builder on every call
Every setter returns the builder so calls chain
Each setter stores its value in the matching field
build() with nothing set returns a Message of all None
Fields that were never set stay None
A full chain builds the expected Message
Two builders do not share state
A built Message is not changed by later builder calls
